Class Page

java.lang.Object
org.roux.page.Page
public class Page extends Object
The Page is one fixed block of bytes. A hot page is mapped and is still receiving writes. A spilled page keeps a file path and has no mapped bytes. A resident page is a spilled page mapped back into memory. residency() reports HOT, RESIDENT, or SPILLED. The constructor maps a new hot page and writes its header. mapFromBytes(byte[]) copies a spilled slot back into memory. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Page roux-v1.md

  • Constructor Details

    • Page

      public Page(int pageId, int capacity)
      The constructor allocates a hot page in memory. The bytes are aligned to 8. PageHeader.init(MemorySegment, int, int) writes the header.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the number of this page.
      capacity - The capacity is the page size in bytes.

    • Page

      private Page(int pageId, int capacity, Path file)
      The constructor stores a spilled page. The segment is left null. The spilled flag is true.
      Parameters:
      pageId - The page id is the number of this page.
      capacity - The capacity is the page size in bytes.
      file - The file is the spill path.

    • usedBytes

      public int usedBytes()
      The method returns the used-byte count from the header. A page with no segment returns 0.
      Returns:
      The count is the used bytes.

    • remaining

      public int remaining()
      The method returns the unused bytes. The unused count is the capacity minus usedBytes().
      Returns:
      The count is the bytes still free.

    • getGeneration

      public int getGeneration()
      The method returns the generation. The generation is the counter a reader uses to notice a write in progress.
      Returns:
      The generation is the current counter.

    • beginWrite

      public void beginWrite()
      The method starts a write. The generation becomes odd. The same value is written into the page header.

    • endWrite

      public void endWrite()
      The method ends a write. The generation becomes even. The same value is written into the page header.

    • unmapRam

      public void unmapRam()
      The method drops the mapped bytes. The spilled flag becomes true. A live arena is closed.

    • mapFromBytes

      public void mapFromBytes(byte[] used)
      The method maps a copy of packed bytes into a new arena. The copy is limited to the page capacity. The spilled flag stays true. The file path is not changed.
      Parameters:
      used - The bytes are the valid prefix to copy.

    • adoptAsHot

      public void adoptAsHot()
      The method marks this page as the writable hot page. The spilled flag becomes false. Call this after mapFromBytes(byte[]).

    • residency

      public String residency()
      The method reports where the page bytes live. A mapped page that is not spilled returns HOT. A mapped page that is spilled returns RESIDENT. A page with no segment returns SPILLED. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#Page roux-v1.md
      Returns:
      The word is HOT, RESIDENT, or SPILLED.

    • close

      public void close()
      The method zeros the mapped bytes and closes the arena. A page that is already unmapped is left unchanged.
